chapter: Later albums and the Neville connection
title: Neville song revived in a country version
summary: He was surprised by the song's return and places Aaron's version well after Tell It Like It Is.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: We have another question pertaining to the Neville's. You wrote all these things for Art Neville. Right. Which, of course, did very well. And then did very well about two years ago covered in a country version. Did that surprise you when it came back up again?
Very much so. It came out of the woodwork.

Is there a story behind... Okay, there's Art Neville's version of that song and then Aaron Neville did one after that. Was that done right after he came out with Tell It Like It Is, capitalizing on his popularity then?
No, I think right off the toe like it is, they had a fling of things that they were doing with the same producers and so forth during that time. So this was a bit after that. Quite a bit after that.
